text: 蚊子叮菩萨——认错了人
pinyin: wén zi dīng pú sà —— rèn cuò le rén
literal: mosquito · sting · bodhisattva — mistake · wrong · person
natural: A mosquito stings a Buddha statue

meaning.en: A mosquito stinging a statue has picked the wrong target; used when someone has mistaken who they are dealing with.
meaning.zh: 蚊子叮泥塑的菩萨，叮错了对象，比喻认错了人或找错了对象。

examples.zh: 你想找他帮忙？蚊子叮菩萨，认错了人，他从来不管闲事。
examples.en: You want his help? You've got the wrong man; he never gets involved.

examples.zh: 蚊子叮菩萨，你找我借钱可是找错了人。
examples.en: You're asking the wrong person if you want to borrow money from me.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。

text: 冰糖煮黄连——同甘共苦
pinyin: bīng táng zhǔ huáng lián —— tóng gān gòng kǔ
literal: rock sugar · boil · coptis root — together · sweet · share · bitter
natural: Rock sugar boiled with bitter coptis

meaning.en: Sweet and bitter in the same pot; sharing both joys and hardships together.
meaning.zh: 冰糖甜、黄连苦，煮在一起，比喻共同享受幸福，共同承担苦难。

examples.zh: 他们夫妻冰糖煮黄连，同甘共苦走过了三十年。
examples.en: The couple have stuck together through thick and thin for thirty years.

examples.zh: 创业路上，咱们得冰糖煮黄连，同甘共苦。
examples.en: On the road to a start-up, we have to share both the sweet and the bitter.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。

text: 纸糊的灯笼——一点就破
pinyin: zhǐ hú de dēng long —— yī diǎn jiù pò
literal: paper · paste · 's · lantern — one · touch · then · break
natural: A paper lantern that tears at a touch

meaning.en: Fragile and easily seen through; used of weak arguments, lies or people who give way at the slightest push.
meaning.zh: 纸糊的灯笼一碰就破，比喻不堪一击，或一点就透、一戳就穿。

examples.zh: 他的借口是纸糊的灯笼，一点就破。
examples.en: His excuse is paper-thin; one poke and it falls apart.

examples.zh: 别看他嘴上硬，其实纸糊的灯笼，一点就破。
examples.en: He talks tough, but he'd collapse at the first push.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Also said of someone quick to see through things when it means 'one hint and he gets it' (一点就透).
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。也可指人领悟快，一点就透（一点就明白）。

text: 聋子的耳朵——摆设
pinyin: lóng zi de ěr duo —— bǎi shè
literal: deaf person · 's · ears — display
natural: A deaf man's ears are mere decoration

meaning.en: Something that is there but serves no purpose; for things or people that are only for show.
meaning.zh: 聋子的耳朵听不见，只是摆着好看，比喻徒有其表、不起作用。

examples.zh: 这个委员会就是聋子的耳朵，摆设而已。
examples.en: This committee is just for show.

examples.zh: 他那个监督员的头衔，聋子的耳朵——摆设。
examples.en: His title of supervisor is purely decorative.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。

text: 狗嘴里吐不出象牙——说不出好话
pinyin: gǒu zuǐ lǐ tǔ bù chū xiàng yá —— shuō bù chū hǎo huà
literal: dog · mouth · in · spit · not · out · ivory — say · not · out · good · words
natural: You can't get ivory from a dog's mouth

meaning.en: A person of bad character cannot say anything pleasant; used when someone makes nasty remarks.
meaning.zh: 狗嘴里长不出象牙，比喻坏人嘴里说不出好话。

equivalents: a leopard can't change its spots
nothing nice ever comes out of his mouth

examples.zh: 狗嘴里吐不出象牙，他一开口就骂人。
examples.en: As ever, nothing nice comes out of his mouth; he starts swearing the moment he speaks.

examples.zh: 别理他，狗嘴里吐不出象牙。
examples.en: Ignore him; he never has a kind word.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Rude; do not use of someone you want to stay on good terms with. The full saying often appears without the second half.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。带有辱骂意味，不宜对熟人当面说。

text: 老和尚念经——有口无心
pinyin: lǎo hé shang niàn jīng —— yǒu kǒu wú xīn
literal: old · monk · chant · sutra — have · mouth · no · heart
natural: An old monk chanting sutras by rote

meaning.en: Mouthing words without thought or sincerity; doing something mechanically.
meaning.zh: 老和尚念经念得太熟，只是嘴上念，心里不想，比喻说话或做事只是机械重复，不走心。

examples.zh: 他道歉像老和尚念经，有口无心。
examples.en: His apologies are just words; he doesn't mean them.

examples.zh: 你老和尚念经似的，一点诚意都没有。
examples.en: You're just reciting it by rote, without any sincerity.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Can also mean someone speaks carelessly but has no ill intent.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。也可指说话随便、并无恶意。

text: 大风吹倒梧桐树——有人欢喜有人愁
pinyin: dà fēng chuī dǎo wú tóng shù —— yǒu rén huān xǐ yǒu rén chóu
literal: big · wind · blow · fall · parasol tree — some · people · glad · some · people · sad
natural: A gale fells the phoenix tree

meaning.en: The same event pleases some and upsets others; used for mixed reactions to news.
meaning.zh: 大风吹倒梧桐树，有人高兴有人发愁，比喻同一件事情，人们的感受不同。

equivalents: one man's meat is another man's poison

examples.zh: 房价上涨，大风吹倒梧桐树，有人欢喜有人愁。
examples.en: House prices are up; some are delighted and some are distraught.

examples.zh: 成绩一公布，大风吹倒梧桐树——有人欢喜有人愁。
examples.en: When the results came out, some were thrilled and some in tears.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. The second half is also used alone as a comment.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。后半句也常单独用作感叹。

text: 猪八戒耍把式——倒打一耙
pinyin: zhū bā jiè shuǎ bǎ shì —— dào dǎ yī pá
literal: Zhu Bajie · perform · tricks — backwards · hit · one · rake
natural: Pigsy performs, then strikes back with his rake

meaning.en: To accuse your accuser; to blame the victim in order to deflect blame.
meaning.zh: 猪八戒的兵器是九齿钉耙，他耍起来回手一耙，比喻自己有错反咬一口，把责任推给别人。

examples.zh: 明明是他先动手，现在猪八戒耍把式，倒打一耙，说是我的错。
examples.en: He threw the first punch, and now he's turned it around and blamed me.

examples.zh: 猪八戒耍把式，倒打一耙，这种人最难对付。
examples.en: People who turn on their accusers are the hardest to deal with.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. From the rake that is Zhu Bajie's weapon in Journey to the West. 'Dǎo dǎ yī pá' is also used alone as a four-character phrase.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。典出《西游记》中猪八戒的钉耙。“倒打一耙”也常单独使用。

text: 六月的天——孩儿的脸
pinyin: liù yuè de tiān —— hái ér de liǎn
literal: sixth · month · 's · sky — child · 's · face
natural: June weather is like a child's face

meaning.en: Changeable; the weather (or a person's mood) shifts in an instant.
meaning.zh: 六月的天气阴晴不定，像小孩子的脸，说变就变，比喻变化无常。

examples.zh: 六月的天，孩儿的脸，刚才还晴着，转眼就下雨了。
examples.en: June weather is fickle; it was sunny a moment ago and now it's pouring.

examples.zh: 她的脾气就像六月的天，说变就变。
examples.en: Her mood changes as quickly as the weather in June.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Usually the full saying is spoken, often to describe a mood.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。常整句使用，多形容天气或人的情绪。

text: 老虎不吃人——恶名在外
pinyin: lǎo hǔ bù chī rén —— è míng zài wài
literal: tiger · not · eat · people — bad · name · abroad
natural: The tiger doesn't eat people, but its name is feared

meaning.en: Someone is blamed or feared for a reputation they do not deserve (or have not earned by action).
meaning.zh: 老虎不一定吃人，但名声很坏，比喻某人名声不好，让人害怕或误解。

equivalents: give a dog a bad name

examples.zh: 他其实人不坏，老虎不吃人，恶名在外罢了。
examples.en: He's really not so bad; it's just his fearsome reputation.

examples.zh: 老虎不吃人，恶名在外，大家都躲着这位老师。
examples.en: Everyone avoids that teacher because of his reputation, though he's harmless.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。

text: 癞蛤蟆打哈欠——好大的口气
pinyin: lài há ma dǎ hā qiàn —— hǎo dà de kǒu qì
literal: toad · yawn — so · big · 's · tone
natural: A toad yawns, a mighty mouth

meaning.en: A boastful, grandiose statement; speaking with extreme arrogance.
meaning.zh: 癞蛤蟆嘴大，打哈欠更显得口大，比喻说话夸大、口气很大。

examples.zh: 你说要三天赚一百万？癞蛤蟆打哈欠，好大的口气。
examples.en: Making a million in three days? That's quite a boast.

examples.zh: 癞蛤蟆打哈欠，口气不小，先把基础打好吧。
examples.en: Big talk; get the basics right first.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. A pun on 口 meaning 'mouth' and 'tone of voice'.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。“口气”一语双关，既指嘴巴大，又指说话的语气。

text: 癞蛤蟆爬到脚背上——不咬人也膈应人
pinyin: lài há ma pá dào jiǎo bèi shàng —— bù yǎo rén yě gé yìng rén
variants: 癞蛤蟆跳到脚背上——不咬人也膈应人
literal: toad · crawl · onto · instep — not · bite · people · also · disgust · people
natural: A toad on your foot: harmless but revolting

meaning.en: Something that does no real harm but is highly annoying or disgusting.
meaning.zh: 癞蛤蟆爬到脚背上，虽然不咬人，却让人恶心，比喻某人或某事虽不造成大害，却令人厌烦。

examples.zh: 他整天在你面前晃，癞蛤蟆爬到脚背上，不咬人也膈应人。
examples.en: He hangs around all day; not dangerous, but he gets on your nerves.

examples.zh: 这种小人，癞蛤蟆爬到脚背上，不咬人也膈应人。
examples.en: Petty people like that do no real harm, but they turn your stomach.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Usually the whole saying is said, since the second half carries the point.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。因后半句是重点，多整句说出。

text: 鸡蛋里挑骨头——百般挑剔
pinyin: jī dàn lǐ tiāo gǔ tou —— bǎi bān tiāo tī
variants: 鸡蛋里面找骨头——百般挑剔
literal: egg · in · pick · bone — hundred · ways · pick · fault
natural: Picking bones out of an egg

meaning.en: Finding fault where there is none; nitpicking.
meaning.zh: 鸡蛋里本来没有骨头，偏要去挑，比喻故意找碴、百般挑剔。

equivalents: find fault where there is none

examples.zh: 我已经改了三遍了，你还鸡蛋里挑骨头！
examples.en: I've revised it three times and you're still nitpicking!

examples.zh: 婆婆对她总是鸡蛋里挑骨头，百般挑剔。
examples.en: Her mother-in-law always finds fault with everything she does.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Usually just the first half; 鸡蛋里挑骨头 also works as a verb phrase.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。通常只说前半句。

text: 狐狸的尾巴——藏不住
pinyin: hú li de wěi ba —— cáng bù zhù
literal: fox · 's · tail — hide · not · live
natural: A fox can't hide its tail

meaning.en: The truth will out; a bad person eventually reveals their true nature.
meaning.zh: 狐狸再狡猾，尾巴也藏不住，比喻坏人的真面目迟早暴露。

equivalents: the cat is out of the bag

examples.zh: 他装得再好，狐狸的尾巴，终究藏不住。
examples.en: However well he acts, his true colours will show.

examples.zh: 你以为瞒得住？狐狸的尾巴——藏不住。
examples.en: Do you think you can hide it? The truth always comes out.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Compare 露出狐狸尾巴 ('show the fox's tail'), meaning to give oneself away.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。常与“露出狐狸尾巴”连用。

text: 猴子笑兔子尾巴短——彼此彼此
pinyin: hóu zi xiào tù zi wěi ba duǎn —— bǐ cǐ bǐ cǐ
literal: monkey · laugh · rabbit · tail · short — each · other · each · other
natural: A monkey laughs at the rabbit's short tail

meaning.en: Neither has any right to criticise the other; they are in the same boat.
meaning.zh: 猴子也是短尾巴，却笑兔子尾巴短，比喻两者缺点一样，谁也别笑话谁。

equivalents: the pot calling the kettle black
six of one, half a dozen of the other

examples.zh: 你说他迟到？猴子笑兔子尾巴短，彼此彼此。
examples.en: You say he's late? You're no better.

examples.zh: 猴子笑兔子尾巴短，咱们俩半斤八两。
examples.en: We're as bad as each other.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. “彼此彼此” is also a polite reply to a compliment, so context decides the reading.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。“彼此彼此”也是客套话，需视语境理解。

text: 和尚庙里借梳子——找错了门
pinyin: hé shang miào lǐ jiè shū zi —— zhǎo cuò le mén
literal: monk · temple · in · borrow · comb — find · wrong · door
natural: Borrowing a comb at a monastery

meaning.en: Asking the wrong person; seeking something where it cannot be had.
meaning.zh: 和尚没有头发，不用梳子，去和尚庙借梳子，比喻找错了对象。

examples.zh: 你向我借钱？和尚庙里借梳子，找错了门。
examples.en: You want to borrow money from me? Wrong door.

examples.zh: 想从他那儿讨好处，那是和尚庙里借梳子。
examples.en: Expecting favours from him is like borrowing a comb from a monk.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。

text: 苍蝇叮鸡蛋——无孔不入
pinyin: cāng yíng dīng jī dàn —— wú kǒng bù rù
literal: fly · sting · egg — no · crack · not · enter
natural: A fly on an egg finds any crack

meaning.en: Seizing on every possible opening; used of those who exploit any weakness.
meaning.zh: 苍蝇专叮有缝的鸡蛋，比喻坏人抓住一切空子，什么机会都不放过。

examples.zh: 骗子苍蝇叮鸡蛋，无孔不入。
examples.en: Scammers will exploit every loophole.

examples.zh: 苍蝇叮鸡蛋，网络谣言也是无孔不入。
examples.en: Online rumours seep in everywhere.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. In the proverb the egg is often cracked: 苍蝇不叮无缝的蛋.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。俗语有“苍蝇不叮无缝的蛋”。

text: 苍蝇飞进花园里——装疯（蜂）
pinyin: cāng yíng fēi jìn huā yuán lǐ —— zhuāng fēng (fēng)
literal: fly · fly · into · garden · in — pretend · mad (bee)
natural: A fly in the garden pretends to be a bee

meaning.en: Playing the fool; pretending to be mad or ignorant. Pun: 疯 (mad) and 蜂 (bee) sound alike.
meaning.zh: 苍蝇混进花园假装成蜜蜂，谐音“装疯”，比喻假装糊涂或发疯。

examples.zh: 你别苍蝇飞进花园里，装疯卖傻了，我知道你什么都清楚。
examples.en: Stop playing the fool; I know you understand everything.

examples.zh: 他又在苍蝇飞进花园里——装疯呢。
examples.en: He's playing crazy again.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Pun: 疯 (mad) and 蜂 (bee) are both fēng; a fly among flowers is 'posing as a bee', i.e. 装疯 (feigning madness).
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。谐音双关：“蜂”与“疯”同音。

text: 狗熊掰包谷——掰一个丢一个
pinyin: gǒu xióng bāi bāo gǔ —— bāi yī gè diū yī gè
variants: 猴子掰苞谷——掰一个丢一个
literal: bear · snap · corn — snap · one · drop · one
natural: The bear snaps corn and drops each cob

meaning.en: Gaining one thing while losing another; learning something and forgetting something else.
meaning.zh: 黑熊掰玉米，掰一个就丢一个，比喻做事得一样丢一样，没有积累。

equivalents: learn one thing and forget another

examples.zh: 你背单词是狗熊掰包谷，掰一个丢一个。
examples.en: You learn a new word and forget an old one.

examples.zh: 这样做事，狗熊掰包谷，最后一无所获。
examples.en: Working like this, you gain nothing in the end.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. “包谷” is a southern word for maize.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。“包谷”即玉米，南方说法。

text: 蒸笼里的馒头——争（蒸）口气
pinyin: zhēng lóng lǐ de mán tou —— zhēng (zhēng) kǒu qì
literal: steamer · in · 's · steamed bun — strive (steam) · breath
natural: The bun in the steamer 'steams' its breath

meaning.en: To make an effort to prove oneself and earn respect. Pun: 争 (strive) and 蒸 (steam).
meaning.zh: 蒸笼里的馒头靠蒸汽，谐音“争口气”，比喻奋发图强、为自己争得尊重。

examples.zh: 蒸笼里的馒头，咱们也要争口气，把冠军拿回来。
examples.en: Let's prove ourselves and win the title back.

examples.zh: 他蒸笼里的馒头——争口气，终于考上了大学。
examples.en: He made a point of proving himself and finally got into university.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Pun: 争 (strive) sounds like 蒸 (steam), and 争口气 is an idiom meaning 'to do oneself proud'.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。谐音双关：“争”与“蒸”同音。

text: 戴着斗笠亲嘴——差一大截
pinyin: dài zhe dǒu lì qīn zuǐ —— chà yī dà jié
literal: wear · bamboo hat · kiss — lack · one · big · section
natural: Kissing while wearing a broad hat

meaning.en: There is a long way to go; the gap is still large.
meaning.zh: 戴着大斗笠亲嘴，斗笠隔着，够不着，比喻相差很远。

examples.zh: 我跟他比，戴着斗笠亲嘴，差一大截。
examples.en: Compared with him, I'm nowhere near.

examples.zh: 想拿冠军？戴着斗笠亲嘴，你还差一大截呢。
examples.en: You want the title? You've got a long way to go.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。

text: 腊月的萝卜——冻（动）了心
pinyin: là yuè de luó bo —— dòng (dòng) le xīn
literal: twelfth · month · 's · radish — frozen (stirred) · le · heart
natural: A radish frozen to the core in winter

meaning.en: To be tempted or moved; to start to change one's mind. Pun: 冻 (frozen) and 动 (stirred).
meaning.zh: 腊月的萝卜冻心，谐音“动了心”，比喻心里被打动或产生了想法。

examples.zh: 看到那么高的工资，他腊月的萝卜——冻了心。
examples.en: Seeing such a high salary, he was tempted.

examples.zh: 她腊月的萝卜，冻了心，打算接受这份工作。
examples.en: She has been won over and is going to take the job.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Pun: 冻 and 动 are homophones (dòng). Also said with the halves reversed: 霜后的萝卜——动（冻）了心.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。谐音双关：“冻”“动”同音。

text: 包公断案——铁面无私
pinyin: bāo gōng duàn àn —— tiě miàn wú sī
variants: 开封府的包公——铁面无私
开封府的包青天——铁面无私
literal: Lord Bao · judge · case — iron · face · no · selfishness
natural: Lord Bao judges a case

meaning.en: Strictly impartial and incorruptible; judging without favour.
meaning.zh: 宋代包拯断案公正，不徇私情，比喻公正严明，不讲情面。

examples.zh: 他像包公断案，铁面无私，谁来说情都没用。
examples.en: He's strictly impartial, and no one's pleading helps.

examples.zh: 裁判要包公断案，铁面无私。
examples.en: A referee must be strict and impartial.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Bao Zheng (999–1062) of the Song dynasty became the model of the upright judge in folklore and opera.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。包拯（999—1062）为宋代名臣，民间戏曲中是清官的典型。

text: 曹操吃鸡肋——食之无味，弃之可惜
pinyin: cáo cāo chī jī lèi —— shí zhī wú wèi, qì zhī kě xī
literal: Cao Cao · eat · chicken rib — eat · it · no · taste, discard · it · pity
natural: Cao Cao and the chicken rib

meaning.en: Something of little value that is still hard to give up.
meaning.zh: 曹操以鸡肋喻汉中，吃着没味，扔了可惜，比喻价值不大但舍不得放弃的东西。

equivalents: not worth much but hard to discard

examples.zh: 这个旧项目，曹操吃鸡肋，食之无味，弃之可惜。
examples.en: This old project is not worth much, but it's a pity to drop it.

examples.zh: 那份工作就像曹操吃鸡肋，我一直拿不定主意。
examples.en: That job is like Cao Cao's chicken rib; I can't make up my mind.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Source: Cao Cao's remark about Hanzhong, in the Three Kingdoms accounts (the 'chicken rib' story).
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。典出三国曹操以“鸡肋”为夜间口令的故事。

text: 孙悟空七十二变——神通广大
pinyin: sūn wù kōng qī shí èr biàn —— shén tōng guǎng dà
variants: 孙猴七十二变——神通广大
孙悟空七十二变——花样多
literal: Sun Wukong · seventy-two · transformations — divine · powers · wide · great
natural: Monkey King and his seventy-two transformations

meaning.en: Extremely resourceful and able to do almost anything.
meaning.zh: 孙悟空会七十二般变化，本领高强，比喻本事极大，办法很多。

examples.zh: 他是孙悟空七十二变，神通广大，什么门路都有。
examples.en: He's a wizard who has connections everywhere.

examples.zh: 总经理像孙悟空七十二变，难题到他手里都能解决。
examples.en: The manager is a miracle worker; any problem is solved in his hands.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Journey to the West is the source. The other form 花样多 stresses variety of tricks.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。典出《西游记》。
